texts.zh:
我们并不是[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的[from.GetName]的第一位访客。这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球上所蕴含的待开发资源已经足以引人注目，而我们更是发现了一座停泊于高层轨道的古老且装饰华丽的信标。[from.GetName]显然属于某个远古的太空文明，但我们尚未发现他们在此处有任何的定居或勘探的迹象。

可能的理论有很多，但证据迫使我们考虑存在这么一个古老的文明，崇敬着这个郁郁葱葱的星球。我们只能猜测他们目前的下落——也就是说，假设他们仍然存在。
texts.en:
We are not the first to visit [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. This [from.GetClassAdj] world is remarkable enough for its abundance of untouched resources, but we also found an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy perched in high orbit. [from.GetName] was clearly known to some ancient, spacefaring civilization, but we can find no evidence that they settled or even prospected here.

Theories abound, but evidence compels us to consider an ancient civilization which once revered this lush world. We can only guess as to their current whereabouts - that is, assuming they still exist.

texts.zh:
在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中，[from.GetName]有过神圣触碰的痕迹。我们位于[root.GetName]上的研究人员表示这个地方充满着深深的崇敬感，在高轨道上发现的一座古老的、装饰华丽的标记信标更加印证了这一说法。

我们相信[from.GetName]曾一度被视为圣体或者圣地而得到崇拜。至于是谁，我们尚且不知道——我们最好的猜测是，他们是一个已经衰落的唯心主义文明。
texts.en:
There is a touch of the Divine about [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Our researchers aboard the [root.GetName] suggest an aura of deep reverence about this place, backed by their discovery of an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy in high orbit.

We believe [from.GetName] may once have been worshipped as a deity, or else it was considered a holy place. To whom, we do not yet know - but our best theories suggest a spiritually-minded civilization which has since fallen into decline.

texts.zh: 我们对[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系中的这颗郁郁葱葱的行星[from.GetName]进行了调查，结果表明，它曾经是另一种未知生命形式非常感兴趣的对象。我们在高轨道上发现了一个古老的导航信标，这表明，这颗行星曾有过外星访客，但在过去的几个世纪里，没有任何登陆或殖民的证据。相反，似乎有什么东西可以在保护这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球——但就目前情况而言，对于这样一个假定的实体，其命运和下落我们依旧不得而知。
texts.en: Our survey of [from.GetName] suggests this bountiful world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was once a subject of keen interest to some other, as yet unknown, life-form. An ancient navigation buoy in high orbit implies the planet has seen alien visitors, but there is no evidence of landfall or colonization in the past few centuries. Instead something seems to have preserved this [from.GetClassAdj] world - but the current fate or whereabouts of such a hypothetical entity are as yet unknown to us.

texts.zh:
我们怀疑，对于[from.GetName]而言，还存在比丰富的资源和原始的自然环境更重要的东西。奇怪的是，[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系里的这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球除了在高轨道上有一座古老的、闪闪发光的信标外，它没有受到过任何影响。这台装置的外壳上蚀刻着复杂的图案，虽然还不是非常肯定，但我们相信这种美术形式应该源自附近的[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]。

他们对我们的态度相当捉摸不透，所以我们只能猜测[spi_fallen_empire.GetAdj]对这颗星球有何规划。至少没有迹象表明我们对[from.GetName]的兴趣冒犯到了他们……
texts.en:
We suspect there is more to [from.GetName] than rich resources and a pristine ecosphere. This [from.GetClassAdj] world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system lies curiously untouched save for an ancient, gleaming marker buoy in high orbit. Intricate designs have been etched into the hull of this device, and though we cannot say with certainty: we believe the origins of this artistry lie with the nearby [spi_fallen_empire.GetName].

So inscrutable is their attitude towards us, we can only speculate upon [spi_fallen_empire.GetAdj] designs for this world. There is at least no indication yet that our interest in [from.GetName] has caused them any offense...

texts.zh:
在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中，[from.GetName]有过神圣触碰的痕迹。我们位于[root.GetName]上的研究人员表示这个地方充满着深深的崇敬感，在高轨道上发现的一座古老的、装饰华丽的标记信标更加印证了这一说法。

我们相信[from.GetName]被视为圣体而崇拜，或者说是被视为圣地一般。信标的装饰风格暗示，可能就是[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]在崇拜这个地方。不清楚现在是否还是如此。
texts.en:
There is a touch of the Divine about [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Our researchers aboard the [root.GetName] suggest an aura of deep reverence about this place, backed by their discovery of an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy in high orbit.

We believe [from.GetName] was worshipped as a deity, or else has been regarded as a holy place. The decorative styling on the buoy suggests it may even be the [spi_fallen_empire.GetName] who once revered this place. It is unclear whether or not that is still the case.

texts.zh:
我们对[from.GetName]的调查表明，这颗位于[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系中的丰饶行星曾经是一个先进——但多愁善感的——生命形式所热衷的对象。其高轨道上有一个停用已久的导航信标，蚀刻着一些与[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]文化相似的设计纹路。

似乎[spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]曾经发誓要保护这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球，但至于现在是否仍是如此我们不得而知。
texts.en:
Our survey of [from.GetName] suggests this bountiful world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was once a subject of keen interest to an advanced - though sentimental - life-form. A long-disused navigation buoy in high orbit has been etched with intricate designs similar to those displayed by the [spi_fallen_empire.GetName].

It seems the [spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] once sought to preserve this [from.GetClassAdj] world, though they give no indication if that is still the case.

label.zh: 我们也应该崇敬这个地方。
label.en: We shall honor this place also.
It is ours for the taking.

label.zh: 我们可以在此发展繁荣。

summary.text:
# 遭遇圣地 / Holy World Encountered

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/fallen_empire_events.txt:694-900; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1140 on_survey_planet · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

用科学船勘测一颗无殖民地的“圣地”（holy_planet 修正）时（on_survey_planet，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1140），若存在灵性堕落帝国（fallen_empire_2）、玩家非AI/非 Scion 起源且未遇见过圣地，弹出 fallen_empires.100（只触发一次，encountered_holy_world）。

Surveying an uncolonised "Holy World" (holy_planet modifier) with a science ship (on_survey_planet, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1140), when a spiritualist fallen empire (fallen_empire_2) exists, the player is human and not Scion origin and has not met a holy world yet, shows fallen_empires.100 (once, encountered_holy_world).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一个窗口：正文分6种（是否灵性/集群/已与灵性堕落帝国通讯）；选项：好奇（团结）；a 以尊敬之心看待（灵性或合作立场）；b 此地应归我们（扩张立场或集群，需已接触）；c 可以在此繁荣；d/e 对堕落帝国的轻蔑态度，各有立场限制。圣地被毁的后果见“圣地”故事（event-planet-destruction-600）。

One window with six text variants (spiritualist, gestalt, or not; already in contact with the spiritualist fallen empire or not). Options: curious (unity); a revere it (spiritualist or cooperative stance); b ours for the taking (expansionist stance or gestalt, in contact); c we could thrive there; d/e scorn for the fallen empire, each stance-gated. What happens when a holy world is destroyed is in the "Holy World" story (event-planet-destruction-600).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

选项按立场互斥。

Options are exclusive by stance.
